meta_title: C&C Fine Decorating | Painter & Decorator Bristol
meta_description: C&C Fine Decorating is your Bristol painter and decorator. Interior and exterior work, wallpapering, and spray finishes. Free quotes, meticulous attention to detail.
hero_subhead: From tired walls to show-home finishes. We handle everything from feature walls to complete redecorating—no job too small.
services_subhead: We specialise in interior and exterior painting, wallpapering, spray finishes, and bespoke colour consultation—all delivered with meticulous attention to detail.

services.title: Interior Painting & Redecorating
services.desc: Complete room makeovers—walls, ceilings, woodwork, and fitted furniture. We prep thoroughly, protect your belongings, and leave your home pristine.

services.title: Exterior Painting & Rendering
services.desc: Weatherproof your home. We paint fascias, soffits, doors, and external walls using quality exterior coatings that last.

services.title: Wallpapering & Feature Walls
services.desc: Bespoke wallpaper selection and installation. From contemporary patterns to period finishes, we handle tricky alcoves and chimney breasts.

services.title: Spray Finishing & Cabinet Painting
services.desc: Smooth, durable spray finishes for kitchen cabinets, doors, and furniture—no brush marks, professional showroom quality.

services.title: Colour Consultation & Design
services.desc: Not sure which colours work? We advise on schemes that suit your space, light, and style—included in every quote.

services.title: Commercial Painting & Maintenance
services.desc: Office, retail, and hospitality repainting. We work flexibly around your business hours and maintain professional standards throughout.

about_pullquote: We treat every wall as if it's in our own home—carefully prepared, expertly finished, on time.
about_para_1: C&C Fine Decorating was founded on the principle that good decoration isn't just about paint—it's about preparation, precision, and respect for your space. Over 15 years, we've completed hundreds of projects across Bristol, from period terraces to modern new builds. Our reputation rests on thorough prep work, attention to detail, and honest communication from quote to handover.
about_para_2: We're meticulous. We turn up on time, protect your furniture and floors, clean as we go, and never cut corners on preparation—which is why many of our customers come back, and why their friends call us too. We listen to what you want, advise on what works, and deliver results you'll enjoy for years.
reviews_heading: What Bristol Homeowners Say About C&C

reviews.text: Booked C&C for a full interior repaint after years of tired magnolia. Chris was brilliant—really took time to discuss colours, sorted the prep work properly, and the finish is immaculate. No mess left behind either. Very fair price. Highly recommend.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Had our kitchen cabinets sprayed. Honestly didn't expect the quality. They look brand new, not a brush mark in sight. The team were polite, worked around us, and the whole job was done in two days. Worth every penny.
reviews.author: Claire M.

reviews.text: Exterior fascia and soffit needed urgent attention before winter. Got a quote same day, work scheduled within a week, and finished on time. Professional outfit. Will use them again for the inside next spring.
reviews.author: Robert K.
